user.description: Enter the MQTT topics rtl_433 publishes each probe's events to. The number at the end is the probe ID, which you can find in Settings → Devices & services → MQTT → Configure → Listen to a topic (listen to `rtl_433/events/ThermoPro-TempSpikeXR/#`).
